title: Task claim and group authorization behavior violates integration expectations
notes: Cluster D from the final integration run: TC-ISS-102-02/04/05/08 and TC-IDN-02-06/07 fail around concurrent claim winner selection, NotPending, completion by the claimed user, authorization, and group membership behavior. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 8595-8686 and 16875-23074.
root_cause: Already resolved by two later, separately-tracked fixes before this WF-03 run started: (1) ISS-0619/GH-568 (commit eea8b9f, 2026-08-08) replaced an unconditional deny in src/api/routes/tasks.zig handleComplete Branch 3 with a live identity.canClaimGroupTask(...) group-membership check, fixing TC-IDN-02-06/07. (2) ISS-0124/GH-390 (commit 3bc063b, 2026-08-02) fixed 15+ PostgreSQL C42883 asymmetric type-cast errors across 8 files one day after this issue was filed, from the same failing full-suite run window; TC-ISS-102-02/04/05/08 exercise TaskStore.claimTask's single-statement atomic UPDATE ... WHERE claimed_by IS NULL AND status='PENDING' RETURNING ... compare-and-swap (already correct at the time of filing) and task_routes.handleComplete's claimed_by-only ownership check — a C42883 error on a related query path is the most plausible explanation for the original failures, since it surfaces to Zig as a generic PoolError/InvalidInput indistinguishable from a logic defect on first read.
candidate_resolution: Define one transactional claim/complete state machine, enforce atomic pending-to-claimed updates, and centralize user/group authorization checks against the same membership source used by both operations.

resolution.summary: Verification-only WF-03 run. Re-ran all 6 named tests (plus their 9 sibling tests in the same 2 files, 15 total) against a live, freshly migrated PostgreSQL test database, 6 consecutive times each -- 100% pass, including the two-real-OS-thread concurrency test TC-ISS-102-02. No production code changes were needed; the claim/complete authorization logic already satisfies all 4 ISS-0115 acceptance criteria (atomic single-statement claim CAS, claimed_by-only completion, USER-assignee completion, GROUP-membership completion). Added a dedicated `zig build test-integration-idn02` narrow target (build.zig, additive only) so tests/integration/idn02_group_management_test.zig has the same fast isolated regression coverage as the existing test-integration-iss102 target, instead of only being reachable via the full test-integration aggregate. No test assertions were loosened; no authorization check was widened.

prevention: When a full-suite integration run reports a generic InvalidInput/500-mapped failure for a claim/complete test, check for PostgreSQL C42883 (asymmetric type cast) in the query path before assuming an authorization-logic defect -- a cast error and a logic defect surface identically to the Zig caller.

Added zig build test-integration-idn02 as a narrow, fast target for tests/integration/idn02_group_management_test.zig so this cluster's regression status can be checked in ~1s instead of via the multi-minute full test-integration aggregate.
